evidence.title: CSS Gradient – Generator, Maker, and Background

name: CSS Gradient
summary: Free CSS gradient generator with a visual picker, copy-ready CSS, plus a swatch gallery, color shade pages and tutorials.
description: A browser tool for building linear and radial CSS gradient backgrounds: pick colors or paste hex values, set stops and angles, and copy the generated CSS. Around the generator sit a swatch gallery of popular gradients with code, color shade pages, gradient examples from real sites (Stripe, Instagram) and a blog explaining gradient syntax.
contains: gradient generator with picker, hex input, up to 5 stops and CSS output
max compatibility (IE6+) mode for old browsers
gradient swatch gallery with copy-ready code
color shade pages: pink, yellow, red, blue, green, purple
gradient examples from real websites (Stripe, Instagram)
blog and resources on linear, radial and text gradients
